metadata.description: UniFi MCP plugins — manage Ubiquiti UniFi infrastructure from Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw

plugins.name: unifi-network
plugins.description: UniFi Network MCP server — manage network devices, clients, firewall, VPN, and more

plugins.name: unifi-protect
plugins.description: UniFi Protect MCP server — manage security cameras, NVR, recordings, and smart detections

plugins.name: unifi-access
plugins.description: UniFi Access MCP server — manage door locks, credentials, visitors, and access policies

plugins.name: unifi-sitemanager
plugins.description: Read-only UniFi Site Manager cloud inventory, ISP metrics and SD-WAN across the whole account

plugins.name: unifi-drive
plugins.description: UniFi Drive MCP server — read NAS storage pools, disk health and shared drives, and manage file services and NFS clients

plugins.name: unifi-innerspace
plugins.description: UniFi InnerSpace MCP server — read floor plans, placed devices and walls, and edit a plan's layout with previews

plugins.name: unifi-intelligence
plugins.description: UniFi Intelligence skills — investigate Network device incidents with Protect camera context; requires the unifi-network and unifi-protect plugins
